current_difficulty_reason: Coornaert’s visual-boundary dimension theorem alone does not compare the Euclidean dimension of the symmetric projective limit set with the highest-weight critical exponent. The authors prove a uniform primal-dual boundary estimate from Hilbert cross ratios, supporting hyperplanes and angle bounds, controlling both point and tangent-hyperplane distances. This new geometric comparison supplies the required dimension inequality before the formal entropy and Hausdorff-dimension conclusion.
